summary: C standard-library strrchr implementation: scans a1 backward from its final NUL and returns a pointer to the last byte equal to a2, or 0 when no match exists. The ABI lead names this CRT__strrchr and the behavior matches the CRT contract exactly.

operations.description: Compute backward scan length v2 = strlen(a1) + 1 and place v3 at the last character a1[v2 - 1].
do-while loop scanning from the string end toward the start, comparing each byte *v3 with a2 until a match is found or the start is reached.
If v2 reaches zero the loop breaks, meaning the whole string was scanned without a match.
v5 = v3 + 1, one byte past the last compared position; this is the candidate match location.
Confirm the match: if *v5 == a2 the byte was found, otherwise the scan ended at the string start.
Return v5 (pointer to the last occurrence of a2) on match, otherwise return 0.
